system.description: You bury four jars of graveyard dirt at the corners of a property.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the living can sleep there.
outcomes.success: In a 200' radius, time stops for the dead: corpses do not rot, and Undead cannot cross the boundary. The living cannot sleep there, for the air is full of a constant, silent screaming.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the jars are only dirt.
outcomes.ruin: The dead are drawn to the boundary, and wait there. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
